title: Movement (internal transfer between treasury accounts)
description: An internal transfer of one asset between two treasury accounts. INVARIANTS (finance/treasury/treasury.go Movement): FromAccountID and ToAccountID are DISTINCT non-empty accounts; Amount is a strictly POSITIVE exact decimal MAGNITUDE ('positive = into ToAccount') - the direction lives in the account pair, not in the sign; Reason is NON-EMPTY, because internal capital that moves without a stated reason is unauditable. OccurredAt is Unix milliseconds and is supplied by the caller (an event time), not by the store.

amount.description: Strictly POSITIVE magnitude (direction lives in the account pair, not in the sign). Zero and negative are both invalid.
